cases.name: Tharifah "Tharifa" Wenrich
cases.about: Tharifa ran a blog and social media group called "Be A Better You" which focused on aging gracefully. Tharifa was one of the authors of "20 Lives Ignited: How 20 Women Over 60 are Creating Success on Their Own Terms."
